title: XSS-like query strings cause Tantivy search to fail silently
description:
## CONTEXT BLOCK - **File/Function:** `doc_transformer/src/main.rs:712-767` (Tantivy search path) - **The Smell:** The code assumes Tantivy can handle any query string, but HTML/XSS-like queries (e.g., ``) cause Tantivy search to fail, triggering silent fallback to INDEX.json search. This masks errors and may indicate query parsing vulnerabilities. ## Evidence ``` $ ./doc_transformer search '' --index-dir /tmp/indexed_output Query: "" Tantivy search failed, falling back to INDEX.json # <-- FAILURE Searching 3 documents No results found ``` Compare to normal query: ``` $ ./doc_transformer search 'Rust' --index-dir /tmp/indexed_output Query: "Rust" Using Tantivy index # <-- SUCCESS Results: ... ``` ## SPECIFICATION BLOCK ### EARS (Easy Approach to Requirements Syntax) - When a query contains special characters (<, >, &, etc.), the system SHALL escape or sanitize them before passing to Tantivy - When Tantivy search fails, the system SHALL log the specific error reason (not just silently fall back) - When falling back to JSON search, the system SHALL indicate the reason for fallback ### DbC (Design by Contract) - **Preconditions:** Query is validated for length and format - **Postconditions:** Tantivy processes all valid queries without exceptions; fallback only occurs for index issues (not query parsing) ### Schema & Edge Cases - **Characters to handle:** `<`, `>`, `&`, `"`, `'`, `\`, `/` - **Edge cases:** - Balanced HTML tags: `
test
` - Unbalanced tags: `
